arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import datetime as dt
from humanize import naturaldelta, naturaltime, precisedelta

# Test R2: year-level precision in naturaldelta and precisedelta
print('=== R2 Tests ===')
print('naturaldelta(370 days):', repr(naturaldelta(dt.timedelta(days=370))))
print('precisedelta(370 days):', repr(precisedelta(dt.timedelta(days=370))))

# Test R3: Large time deltas
print()
print('=== R3 Tests ===')
huge = dt.timedelta(days=999999999)
print('naturaldelta huge:', repr(naturaldelta(huge)))
print('naturaltime huge:', repr(naturaltime(huge)))

# Test with datetime far in past that would overflow
try:
    old = dt.datetime.now() - dt.timedelta(days=999999999)
    print('naturaldelta old datetime:', repr(naturaldelta(old)))
except Exception as e:
    print('Error with old datetime:', type(e).__name__, str(e)[:100])

# Test R5: metric function spacing
print()
print('=== R5 Tests ===')
from humanize import metric
print('metric(1, \"Hz\"):', repr(metric(1, 'Hz')))
print('metric(-1500, \"V\"):', repr(metric(-1500, 'V')))
print('metric(3, \"W\", 5):', repr(metric(3, 'W', 5)))
print('metric(1, \"°\"):', repr(metric(1, '°')))
print('metric(1000, \"m/s\"):', repr(metric(1000, 'm/s')))

# Test R6: intcomma ndigits=0
print()
print('=== R6 Tests ===')
from humanize import intcomma
print('intcomma(1234.56789, ndigits=0):', repr(intcomma(1234.56789, ndigits=0)))
print('intcomma(1234.5, ndigits=0):', repr(intcomma(1234.5, ndigits=0)))
print('intcomma(1234, ndigits=0):', repr(intcomma(1234, ndigits=0)))
"
